compiled_state.title: Make forbidden-action HARD-GATEs in brainstorm/sprint/fix-bug/implementation-plan load-bearing via tool-use-time enforcement
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context

Multi-skill HARD-GATEs in brainstorm, sprint, fix-bug, and implementation-plan SKILL.md files prohibit specific actions during specific phases — e.g., "do not write code until brainstorm Phase 3", "do not dispatch new sprint batch without committing previous", "do not skip fix-bug phase ordering". A bot-psychologist Probe B during the sibling epic's brainstorm confirmed this same psychology applies: gates reachable when challenged, not load-bearing during silent execution. The sibling epic's fix (post-hoc artifact verification) does not fit forbidden-action gates because they concern actions that haven't happened yet (or shouldn't). The fix shape is tool-use-time enforcement via PreToolUse hooks that block forbidden tool calls during specific phases, sourcing phase state from durable session metadata that the relevant skills already track.

This is a stub epic created during the sibling epic's brainstorm session as an explicitly-named follow-on. It requires its own /dso:brainstorm session before implementation — the SCs below are stub-quality and will be refined, scrutinized via the full pipeline, and approved during that session.

## Success Criteria

- A phase-aware PreToolUse hook intercepts tool calls and blocks them when the active phase (per durable session state) forbids that tool/action class. Test fixture: an agent attempting Edit during brainstorm Phase 1 is blocked.
- Each existing forbidden-action HARD-GATE in brainstorm, sprint, fix-bug, and implementation-plan SKILL.md is enumerated and mapped to a (skill, phase, forbidden-tool-or-action) tuple consumed by the hook.
- Override mirrors the sibling epic's pattern: user-invoked dso forbidden-action-override --reason="..." (one-shot, audited; agent cannot self-authorize; respects dso-fbky autonomous mode).
- Zero false positives on representative session-level traces of brainstorm, sprint, fix-bug, and implementation-plan flows (each runs a happy-path session end-to-end with the new hook active and produces no spurious blocks).

## Dependencies

Blocked by the sibling epic (wrapper-driven artifact verification for HARD-GATE per-step workflow compliance) — the override-path infrastructure (dso commit-override audit-trail pattern), the artifacts-dir / get_artifacts_dir() worktree-resolution logic, and the session-state-aware hook installation pattern are all reused.

## Approach

To be designed in this epic's own /dso:brainstorm session. Indicative shape: PreToolUse hook reads phase state from skill session artifacts (the same durable state that brainstorm/sprint/fix-bug skills track today for resume), evaluates the in-flight tool call against a (skill, phase) -> forbidden-set table, blocks with a structured error directing the agent to either complete the prerequisite phase work or surface to the user for an explicit override.
